attributes.description: This dashboard provides a comprehensive view of vulnerability intelligence events detected in the user's environment using Google Threat Intelligence data.

params.markdown:
This dashboard provides a comprehensive view of vulnerability correlation events detected in the user's environment using Google Threat Intelligence data. It delivers insights into detected events over time, along with categorized breakdowns by exploitation state, priority, risk rating, and status.

Key metrics include the total number of detected vulnerability events. Events are further analyzed by the top 10 source event datasets and modules to help identify where the correlated vulnerabilities originated.

Saved searches streamline investigations by summarizing detected vulnerability events along with their CVSS v2, CVSS v3, CVSS v3 (translated), and CVSS v4 scoring details.

[**Integrations Page**](/app/integrations/detail/ti_google_threat_intelligence/overview)
